column1: # Ready a weapon and then a second one, to measure the R-Ready refusal for a
# slot that is already filled - `inventory.md` section 5 describes the
# hand-occupancy branch but publishes none of its lines (cleak/u5-spec#225).
# Character-creation Strength draw, as in `hut-ready-picker`. Seven `a`
# answers do not fix the Avatar's Strength: the tournament pairs are drawn at
# random (`chargen.md` §6) and the Dagger readies only above the floor of 20.
# In all 34 captures that reached the beat the stock refused it; the engine readied it
# 20261020-131233), which is what put all three beats out of step. That was
# an engine bug, not the dice: its visual chargen drew virtues from a pool
# that walked `0..128` from a clock offset - eight outcomes, two of them
# Strength 21 for all-`A` answers - instead of the game-logic generator
# (`prng.md` §2, §3), which gives Strength 21 for 51 of the 4,096 host-clock
# seeds. Fixed on rc4; each side still draws Strength 21 about one run in 80,
# so a run whose first beat shows one side readying the Dagger is a re-run.
